$comment: Veo's own analysis of this match, recovered from captured accessibility trees of the live app.veo.co page. This is a BENCHMARK TO MATCH OR BEAT, not ground truth and not seed data. Never load this into the app as fixture data.

provenance.captured_by: Antigravity browser session, authenticated as the account owner
provenance.method: accessibility-tree text, not a network/API capture

time_base.$comment: RESOLVED 2026-09-17 by sampling frames from the source video. Shot-map timestamps are MATCH CLOCK, not video time. Convert before scoring.

confirmed_by_frame_inspection.evidence: Frames at 10s/120s/300s/480s show warmup on a near-empty pitch. t=540s shows teams forming up. t=561s shows a textbook kickoff formation: players ringed around the centre circle with one at the spot.
confirmed_by_frame_inspection.half_length_note: 2961 - 561 = exactly 2400s = 40:00. U16 ECNL plays 40-minute halves, so this is a strong structural confirmation rather than a coincidence.
confirmed_by_frame_inspection.halftime_evidence: Active play at 2900s. Pitch empties by 2980s and stays empty through 3300s. Teams regather by 3460s.

conversion.second_half_derivation: Second half kicks off at video ~3480s at match clock 2400s, so offset = 1080.

time_base.corroboration: Applying these offsets places all 13 attempts inside the video, and the last one (79:51 -> video 5871s) lands 9 seconds before the predicted second-half end at 5880s, with ~5 minutes of post-match footage remaining to reach the 6172s total. Independent arithmetic agreeing to within 9s is good evidence the offsets are right.
time_base.residual_uncertainty: The second-half kickoff was bracketed to 3380-3500s by frame sampling, so the +1080 offset carries roughly +/-40s. Pin it precisely before tight-tolerance scoring by bisecting frames in that window for the restart.
time_base.not_confirmed: No individual goal has been visually verified. Frames around the predicted first goal (video 772s) show a ball airborne at 770s, play switching ends by 775s, and centre-circle activity at 795s - consistent with a goal and restart, but stills cannot prove it. Watching video 765-800s would settle it in under a minute.

home_shot_map.$comment: From the Analytics drawer Shot map section. Chronological. Veo displays one team's shot map at a time; this is the HOME side. Self-consistent with home_stats below: 3 goals + 10 shots = 13 total attempts. video_s is DERIVED via time_base.conversion above, not captured.

home_stats.$comment: Veo's published aggregate figures for the home side.

event_vocabulary.$comment: The 15 event types Veo emits, recovered from the Events drawer. Our clone currently implements only 7.

UNRESOLVED.away_shot_map: Not captured - Veo shows one team's shot map at a time and only the home side was captured. So recall can only be scored for the home side; an away-side detection is neither a hit nor a false positive against this set.
UNRESOLVED.per_event_timestamps: The Events drawer capture contains ~390 event-type buttons but WITHOUT timestamps. Only these 13 shot-map entries carry times. A fresh capture pass would be needed for a full-vocabulary scored comparison.

scoring_protocol.$comment: How to use this file. Report results honestly, including losses.
scoring_protocol.primary_metric: Goal detection: the pipeline must find goals at video_s 772, 2957 and 5516 within a stated tolerance. Use +/- 30s until the second-half offset is pinned tighter, since its own uncertainty is +/-40s. 3 of 3 is parity with Veo.
scoring_protocol.secondary_metric: Shot/attempt detection: precision and recall against all 13 home attempts.
rules: Score against video_s, never against the raw match-clock string.
Report per-event hits and misses, not just an aggregate.
A false positive is as reportable as a miss.
Away-side detections cannot be scored against this set; report them separately rather than counting them as errors.
Never tune thresholds on this set and then report the same set as a result. If tuning against it, say so explicitly.
Beating Veo means finding attempts it missed, and that cannot be demonstrated with this file alone - it requires manual review of the specific clip. Claim it only with a timestamp a human confirmed.
